comparisons.baseline_answer: The essay treats epistemic capture as a room preserving a load-bearing object or frame even when credible challenges threaten its coherence, reclassifying the challenger rather than absorbing the challenge. Ordinary error may be corrected without threatening the room; fraud depends on deception or bad faith; groupthink and motivated reasoning describe narrower psychological or social mechanisms.
